notes: Enumerated 193 unique DOI-linked main-track papers across 44 technical sessions.
Four keynotes, one debate, and one WACI session were treated as six non-paper content blocks; lightning-talk and poster presentations duplicate main papers and were not added as separate records.
Twenty-three official-program papers use ACM/Crossref metadata labeled ASPLOS 2023 Volume 4; they are retained under the official ASPLOS 2024 program boundary and flagged for independent review.

All ML-themed papers expose a material architecture, compiler, runtime, communication, scheduling, serving, training-system, or hardware/software co-design mechanism; no paper was excluded as ML-only.
Matched 33 papers to author-deposited archival Zenodo artifact records.
Excluded Zenodo record 11473356 from the artifact matches because its claimed ASPLOS 2024 paper title and authors do not occur in the official 193-paper program.
Captured 189 official lightning-talk links, 128 publisher-deposited PDF links, 55 arXiv alternates, and 4 institutional-repository copies.
Recorded 5 official-program versus Crossref title-rendering differences while preserving the official program title and stable initialized ID.
Retained the complete 49-author published list for PyTorch 2 and flagged the official program’s five-author omission and order discrepancy.
No duplicate DOI, duplicate canonical title, paper-ID collision, or proposed alias was found.
